verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Gemini is a frontier-model API from Google DeepMind. However, the pack has no evidence of published safety evaluations, red-teaming results, model cards, risk assessments, or a frontier safety framework governing releases. The safety items it does contain cover adjacent topics: user-adjustable content filters (gemini-docs-10/16) and a Prohibited Use Policy for customers (gemini-supp-terms). Neither is a vendor-side responsible-release process, so they are not credited.
